paper.citation: Thronsen et al., Ultramicroscopy 255 (2024) 113861, doi:10.1016/j.ultramic.2023.113861 (CC BY 4.0)
paper.data: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6645396 (CC BY 4.0, stays out of the repo; read from References/mac4DSTEM/thronsen-datasetA)

datasetA.scanSizeSource: PDF page 3, Section 2 ('A dataset, termed Dataset A containing 512 x 512')
datasetA.stepNmPaperTextSource: PDF page 3 ('The scan step size was chosen to be 4.6 nm')
datasetA.stepNmFileSource: their datasetA_preprocessed.hspy axes; settled by the owner 2026-09-28, the scale bar of their Fig. 7 agrees; every length and density here uses it
datasetA.stride3Source: References/mac4DSTEM/thronsen-datasetA/datasetA_stride3.h5 (every 3rd row and column of the preprocessed cube; no calibration stored, Q = 0.01904 per px from their file)

datasetB.stepNmSource: PDF page 3 ('the scan step size was set to 2.3 nm'); scan size not found in the text, so null

zoneAxisPatterns.labelsNote: the paper lists six unique patterns: one Al, one theta'[001], two theta'<100> and two T1 in-plane variants (PDF page 3); the labels above are the four phase classes of the ground truth map

paperAccuracyPercent.source: Table 3, PDF page 11; accuracy = deviation from the manually built ground truth map (the 'pixel-by-pixel difference', PDF page 3)

publishedMapsAtStride3AccuracyPercent.source: 100 - the per-position error of the four published maps (Zenodo datasetA_phasemap_*.hspy) at [::3, ::3] against truth_stride3.json: 1.56 / 1.51 / 1.70 / 0.95 % (A3a, 2026-09-28; computed by us, not published)
